caption: The drawing depicts a single, dark brown metal teapot positioned in the center of a plain, light-colored background. The teapot has a round, bulbous body with a lid on top, a short spout extending from the right side, and a curved handle arching above from one side to the other. The surface of the teapot appears textured and slightly mottled in shading, giving it a worn look. The handle and spout are rendered in the same dark hue as the body, with highlights and shadows suggesting three-dimensional form. No other objects or details are present in the drawing, and the negative space around the teapot is uniform and pale. The artist's signature, "FRED HASSEBROCK," is visible in small text toward the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Tea Kettle
